SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nakuru
   D. Mombasa

2. Which statement about Self- Improvement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Self- Improvement as rumours only.
   B. Say Self- Improvement never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Self- Improvement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Improvement.

3. Which statement about Population Growth in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Population Growth in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Population Growth in Africa.
   C. Treat Population Growth in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Explain Population Growth in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain.
   C. Say Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Trans Saharan Slave Trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Trans Saharan Slave Trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Trans Saharan Slave Trade as rumours only.
   C. Say Trans Saharan Slave Trade never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Trans Saharan Slave Trade.

6. Which statement about Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe.
   D. Treat Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Self- Esteem Assessment is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Self- Esteem Assessment never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Self- Esteem Assessment with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Esteem Assessment.
   D. Treat Self- Esteem Assessment as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration.
   C. Say Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Vegetation in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Vegetation in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation in Africa.
   C. Explain Vegetation in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Vegetation in Africa as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Scientific Theory about Human Origin is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Scientific Theory about Human Origin with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Scientific Theory about Human Origin.
   C. Say Scientific Theory about Human Origin never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Scientific Theory about Human Origin as rumours only.

11. Which statement about Diversity and interpersonal skills is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Diversity and interpersonal skills never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Diversity and interpersonal skills.
   C. Treat Diversity and interpersonal skills as rumours only.
   D. Explain Diversity and interpersonal skills with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Trans Saharan Slave Trade and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Population Growth in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Diversity and interpersonal skills and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
